WITH rpt_deals AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.title, src.stage, src.amount, src.currency_code, src.stage_weight, src.weighted_amount, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.company_industry, src.location_id, src.contact_id, src.contact_name, src.contact_email, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.created_at, src.closed_at, src.close_ts, src.updated_at, src.expected_close_date, src.lost_reason, src.is_open, src.is_won, src.is_lost, src.aging_days, src.forecast_category, src.forecast_reason, src.forecast_flagged FROM (
SELECT 
  d.id,
  d.organization_id,
  d.title,
  d.stage,
  COALESCE(d.amount, 0) AS amount,
  CASE
    WHEN pq.currency IS NOT NULL AND pq.currency <> 'USD' THEN pq.currency
    WHEN o.country IS NOT NULL AND o.country <> 'US' AND cc.curr IS NOT NULL THEN cc.curr
    WHEN pq.currency = 'USD' THEN 'USD'
    WHEN o.country = 'US' THEN 'USD'
    ELSE 'USD'
  END AS currency_code,
  CASE d.stage
    WHEN 'qualification' THEN 0.10
    WHEN 'discover' THEN 0.25
    WHEN 'propose' THEN 0.50
    WHEN 'negotiate' THEN 0.75
    WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 1.00
    WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 0.00
    ELSE 0.00
  END AS stage_weight,
  ROUND(COALESCE(d.amount, 0) * (
    CASE d.stage
      WHEN 'qualification' THEN 0.10
      WHEN 'discover' THEN 0.25
      WHEN 'propose' THEN 0.50
      WHEN 'negotiate' THEN 0.75
      WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 1.00
      WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 0.00
      ELSE 0.00
    END
  ), 2) AS weighted_amount,
  d.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  c.industry AS company_industry,
  d.location_id,
  d.contact_id,
  COALESCE(d.contact_name, cdp.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(cdp.last_name, '')) AS contact_name,
  COALESCE(d.contact_email, id_k.key_value) AS contact_email,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  d.created_at,
  d.closed_at,
  COALESCE(d.closed_at, d.created_at) AS close_ts,
  d.updated_at,
  d.expected_close_date,
  d.lost_reason,
  (d.stage IN ('qualification', 'discover', 'propose', 'negotiate')) AS is_open,
  (d.stage = 'closed_won') AS is_won,
  (d.stage = 'closed_lost') AS is_lost,
  FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - d.created_at))/86400)::integer AS aging_days,
  d.forecast_category,
  d.forecast_reason,
  d.forecast_flagged
FROM crm.deals d
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = d.company_id AND c.organization_id = d.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.organizations o ON o.id = d.organization_id
LEFT JOIN cdp.customer_profile cdp ON cdp.cdp_id = d.contact_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ik.key_value 
  FROM cdp.identity_keys ik 
  WHERE ik.cdp_id = d.contact_id AND ik.key_type = 'email' AND ik.organization_id = d.organization_id 
  ORDER BY ik.created_at ASC 
  LIMIT 1
) id_k ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT q.currency 
  FROM crm.quotes q 
  WHERE q.deal_id = d.id AND q.organization_id = d.organization_id 
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 WHEN q.status = 'sent' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, q.updated_at DESC 
  LIMIT 1
) pq ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE o.country 
    WHEN 'India' THEN 'INR' 
    WHEN 'United Kingdom' THEN 'GBP' 
    WHEN 'Germany' THEN 'EUR' 
    WHEN 'Canada' THEN 'CAD' 
    WHEN 'Australia' THEN 'AUD' 
    ELSE 'USD' 
  END AS curr
) cc ON TRUE
WHERE d.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(owner_name AS TEXT), 'Unassigned') AS owner, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS won_revenue FROM rpt_deals AS deals WHERE is_won = TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY COALESCE(CAST(owner_name AS TEXT), 'Unassigned') ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

WITH rpt_invoices AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.invoice_number, src.order_id, src.deal_id, src.deal_title, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.status, src.approval_status, src.subtotal, src.discount_amount, src.tax_amount, src.total, src.currency_code, src.due_at, src.paid_at, src.payment_method, src.created_by_user_id, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.created_at, src.updated_at, src.is_overdue FROM (
SELECT 
  inv.id,
  inv.organization_id,
  inv.number AS invoice_number,
  inv.order_id,
  inv.deal_id,
  d.title AS deal_title,
  inv.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  inv.status,
  inv.approval_status,
  COALESCE(inv.total - COALESCE(inv.tax_amount, 0) + COALESCE(inv.discount_amount, 0), inv.total) AS subtotal,
  COALESCE(inv.discount_amount, 0) AS discount_amount,
  COALESCE(inv.tax_amount, 0) AS tax_amount,
  COALESCE(inv.total, 0) AS total,
  COALESCE(inv.currency, 'USD') AS currency_code,
  inv.due_at,
  inv.paid_at,
  inv.payment_method,
  inv.created_by_user_id,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  inv.created_at,
  inv.updated_at,
  (inv.status = 'overdue' OR (inv.status = 'sent' AND inv.due_at < NOW())) AS is_overdue
FROM crm.invoices inv
LEFT JOIN crm.deals d ON d.id = inv.deal_id AND d.organization_id = inv.organization_id
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = inv.company_id AND c.organization_id = inv.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
WHERE inv.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS collected_revenue, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS paid_invoice_count FROM rpt_invoices AS invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE LIMIT 500
